title: O-GlcNAcFinder: prediction of O-GlcNAc sites from protein language model embeddings
description: O-GlcNAcFinder predicts O-GlcNAc sites on serines and threonines from ESM-2 (150M) embeddings, with calibrated probabilities. Python package, command-line tool, trained model and the worker of the web server (https://bioinfo.dcc.ufmg.br/oglcnacfinder/).
